newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cargolux 4th B747-400F set for delivery next week.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux 4th B747-400F set for delivery next week.

text.p: All-cargo carrier Cargolux Airlines International said it would take delivery of its fourth Boeing 747-400 freighter next week.

"The aircraft will make its maiden cargo-carrying flight between Seattle and Luxembourg on August 27 and will then spend a few days in maintenance before returning to Seattle via Prestwick," Pierre Wesner, Cargolux's vice-president for Europe/Africa/Middle East, told Reuters in an interview.
The airline is to take delivery of a fifth 747-400F in November 1997.
"Strong market demand globally is putting pressure on capacity and we can't take delivery of the additional -400s soon enough," Wesner said.

In a separate development, Cargolux said it had wet-leased a Boeing 747-200 freighter from U.S. carrier Southern Air Transport, following the expiry of a lease agreement for a similar aircraft with Atlas Air.

"The -200 from Southern Air entered service on Sunday and is a direct replacement for the Atlas Air 747-200, which operated between Luxembourg and the U.S. east coast carrying Panalpina-dedicated shipments in the form of IBM components, as well as plying our scheduled Mexico City route," said Wesner.
Cargolux also operates its own fleet of three Boeing 747-200s.
